rate_limits: Unregistered: 25 queries/day, 25 series/query; registered: 500 queries/day, 50 series/query. Also 50 requests per 10 seconds for both registered and unregistered.
resolution_notes: Auditor right on rate_limits: official BLS FAQ states 50 requests per 10 seconds for registered and unregistered users, alongside daily/series caps. Evidence: https://www.bls.gov/developers/api_faqs.htm and https://www.bls.gov/developers/api_signature_v2.htm
